ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Funding Cuts on Child Care Programs
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of federal funding cuts on child care programs across the United States, focusing on Minnesota and other affected states.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records to assess the impact on low-income families and program availability
questions: How many programs have been terminated?
What is the impact on low-income families?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal the extent of the issue and the consequences of federal funding decisions on vulnerable populations.

ideas.title: Investigating Allegations of Mismanagement within the FBI
ideas.description: Probe into allegations of mismanagement within the FBI under Kash Patel's leadership, including misleading statistics and internal issues.
ideas.angle: In-depth investigation using public records and whistleblower accounts
questions: How do these issues affect the FBI's operations?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential wrongdoing within a critical law enforcement agency and shed light on the implications for national security and public trust.
